digest.component_or_area: outbound differ and reconciler adapter seam
propositions: The outbound differ reads raw vendor snapshot keys (accountId, parent.key, ADF description) in core, violating the adapter seam principle that core must not contain vendor-shaped logic or data structures

The inbound differ canonicalizes the remote payload via InboundMapper before comparing, but the outbound differ compares local ticket against raw vendor snapshot, creating asymmetry that blocks epic bbf1 AC3

The update path must canonicalize snapshot entries at ingestion boundary via InboundMapper and emit vendor payloads only at the boundary via new OutboundMapper.map_fields_to_remote method, keeping vendor shape outside core comparison logic

Identity and parent fields (assignee, reporter, parent.key) require new canonical keys (assignee_identity dict, reporter_identity dict, remote_parent_id string) in the InboundMapper output, with exact fixed shapes and presence-guarded mapping of partial baseline subsets

The assignee resolver contract (3-tuple return with accountId fast-path sentinel) moves to OutboundMapper.resolve_assignee parameterized only on canonical assignee_identity shape, preserving all downstream dispatch invariants including _assignee_is_account_id sentinel and non-authoritative fallback

Vendor-shaped comparison helpers (_diff_fields, _extract_jira_field, _assignee_matches, _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE) become adapter-internal; core contains no adapters.jira imports and no raw Jira snapshot key literals (accountId, emailAddress, displayName, issuetype, issuelinks, inwardIssue, outwardIssue)
